# UML generation/verification pipeline — inventory

Two stacks exist:

| Stack | Role |
|---|---|
| **`app/services/*`** (current) | FastAPI/Streamlit path: requirement/code → Stage-1 JSON → PlantUML → validate → repair → render → VLM |
| **`uml_pipeline/*`** (legacy CLI) | Spec → PlantUML → render → VLM; **no** validators, repair, or spec-JSON |

Orchestration lives in `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/orchestration.py` (`run_single_generation`).

---

## 1. Existing validation layers

### A. Syntax (regex, not PlantUML compiler)

**File:** `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/plantuml_validate.py`

| Function | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `ensure_plantuml_bounds` | Strips fences; wraps `@startuml`/`@enduml`; keeps first block only |
| `normalize_plantuml_relations` | Rewrites `A --inheritance--> B;` → `--\|>`; strips `;` on class/attr lines; maps worded rels via `_REL_WORD_MAP` |
| `strip_unsafe_plantuml_directives` | Drops `!include`, `!includeurl`, `!import`, `!pragma`, `!define`, `!theme`, etc. |
| `sanitize_plantuml_output` | Bounds + normalize + strip unsafe + dedupe lines + cap 120 lines + close extra `{` |
| `validate_basic_syntax` | Missing/multiple `@startuml`/`@enduml`; unbalanced `{}`; **empty body** (`<8` chars after stripping title/skinparam); worded arrows `-- word -->` |
| `validate_diagram` | Always `validate_basic_syntax`, then type-specific merge |

**No `validate_class_syntax`.** Class diagrams only get `validate_basic_syntax`.

### B. Render / “compile” gate

**File:** `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/uml_pipeline/render.py`

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `render_plantuml` | Java `plantuml.jar -tpng` first; remote HTTP fallback |
| `_plantuml_render_succeeded` | Rejects Graphviz/dot error images, `syntax error`, `error line`, empty/tiny PNGs |
| `_looks_like_graphviz_error_png` | Neon-green Graphviz error page detector |
| `_ensure_renderable_layout` | Injects `!pragma layout smetana` if Graphviz missing |
| `extract_plantuml_block` | Used by repair + CoT finalize |

**There is no PlantUML `-checkonly` / syntax-compile gate.** Compile = “did a real PNG get written?” Empty diagrams can still render as blank PNGs; `validate_basic_syntax` tries to catch that first.

Wired in `run_single_generation` after static validation; failed render triggers another `repair_plantuml` unless Java/JDK is missing.

### C. Structural (diagram-type heuristics)

Same file: `plantuml_validate.py`, dispatched by `validate_diagram(code, diagram_type)`.

| Function | Type | Checks |
|---|---|---|
| `validate_package_semantics` | package | Non-empty body; `package Name { ... }` (not `package Name;`); nested types or `..>`/`-->`/`+--`; **self-deps** `A ..> A`; dotted peer packages without nesting; duplicate package names; self-containment `A +-- A` |
| `validate_object_syntax` | object | If `object X {` without `object name:Type` → warn |
| `validate_component_syntax` | component | Empty `()` interface lines |
| `validate_flowchart_syntax` | flowchart | Rejects class/object-looking diagrams; requires `:Step;` or `start`; `start` needs `stop`/`end`; no class-style `-->` on activity steps |

**Class:** no inheritance/association/member structural rules.  
**Sequence:** no validator, no builder, no type.

Analytics-only taxonomy (not used by repair):

**File:** `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/package_failures.py`  
`classify_package_failure` / `package_failure_report` → `empty_or_incomplete`, `missing_package_block`, `unbalanced_braces`, `self_dependency`, `invalid_syntax_other`, `render_engine_error`, `wrong_diagram_type`, `unknown`.

### D. Semantic — two very different things

**1. Deterministic (spec coverage, not UML semantics)**

**File:** `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/plantuml_from_spec.py`

| Function | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `fidelity_report` | Entity-name recall (substring/stem); relationship pairs on connector lines; `ModuleN`/`EntityA` placeholders. Pass if recall≥0.75, rel_recall≥0.50, few missing, no generics |
| `ensure_faithful_plantuml` | If `script_without_types` or fidelity fails → **replace** with `plantuml_from_spec` |

This is **name presence**, not type-correctness, hallucination of extra classes, or contradiction vs requirement text.

**File:** `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/spec_json.py`

| Function | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `validate_spec_json` | Schema: `diagram_type`, non-empty `entities` with names, `relationships` list; flowchart needs ≥2 `process_steps` |
| `ensure_valid_spec` | Parse JSON → validate → heuristic fallback → merge `extract_named_concepts` + `extract_nl_relationships` |
| `validity_metrics` | Entity/rel counts, typed-rel count, `json_valid` |
| `structure_to_spec_json` | Code AST-ish: declared classes only; `script_without_types` flag |

**2. VLM scoring (joint 0–6, not decomposed)**

**Files:**  
- `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/scoring.py`  
- `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/uml_pipeline/scoring.py`  
- `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/vlm_scoring.v1.txt`

| Function | Role |
|---|---|
| `orchestration.score_image` | 3 VLMs (or 1 in `vlm_fast_mode`); prompt asks semantic/structural/syntactic/coherence **together** |
| `paper_composite` | Weighted S; **S=0 if render fails** |
| `majority_vote_accept` | `s_j ≥ τ` (default 4); need ≥2 votes (1 in fast mode) |
| `dataset_entry_accepted` | render OK **and** majority **and** S≥3.0 |
| `verify_scores` | Bundles all of the above |

VLM is the **only** semantic-correctness / hallucination / contradiction signal. It is a single integer, not four scores. Mock VLM hashes the image+prompt to 3–5 and does not inspect content.

Human review (`semantic_correctness` 1–5) is separate UI/API, not a pipeline gate.

### E. Repair

**File:** `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/repair.py`  
Prompt: `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/repair_plantuml.v1.txt`

`repair_plantuml(plantuml, specification, diagram_type, errors, repair_notes)`:

1. Calls **base** code provider (not LoRA — LoRA often turns package/flowchart into class).
2. Same generic prompt for every error: “fix so it compiles, matches spec, package nesting, no self-deps.”
3. Sanitizes output, re-runs `validate_diagram`.
4. If still invalid **and** type is `package` or `flowchart` → `MockProvider._plantuml` template.
5. Provider exception → same template fallback.

**Not adaptive by failure category.** `classify_package_failure` is never called from repair. One LLM rewrite + optional template.

Orchestration loop (`run_single_generation`):

```
while attempt <= max_repair_attempts:          # default 3
  if not validate_diagram.ok and attempt < max:
      repair_plantuml(...); persist RepairAttempt; continue
  render_plantuml(...)
  if image: break
  if java/jdk env fail: break                  # do not repair env
  if attempt >= max: break
  repair_plantuml([render error])
# then last-resort plantuml_from_spec / template
```

**Retry limits**

| Knob | Value |
|---|---|
| `Settings.max_repair_attempts` | **3** (`app/settings.py`) |
| Loop bound | `attempt <= 3` → up to **4** validate/render cycles, **3** repairs |
| Extra after loop | 1 deterministic template render |
| Stage-1 JSON | 1 extra LLM retry if invalid JSON |
| Generation fallbacks (not RepairAttempt) | LoRA → base LLM → `plantuml_from_spec` → template |
| Eval scripts | force `max_repair_attempts=1` |
| `scripts/generate_dataset.py` | `max_repair_attempts=0` |

Mock repair (`MockProvider._repair`): for package, emit domain/application template; else strip self-deps or emit two classes.

---

## 2. Supported diagram types

| Type | API/UI (`app/schemas.py`) | Validator | Spec-builder | Prompt registered | LoRA-primary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **class** | yes | basic only | `build_class_plantuml` | `tech_spec_to_class` | yes |
| **object** | yes | `validate_object_syntax` | `build_object_plantuml` | `tech_spec_to_object` | yes |
| **component** | yes | `validate_component_syntax` | `build_component_plantuml` | `tech_spec_to_component` | yes |
| **package** | yes | `validate_package_semantics` (richest) | `build_package_plantuml` | `tech_spec_to_package` | yes |
| **flowchart** (activity) | **no** — `DiagramType` Literal rejects it | `validate_flowchart_syntax` | `build_flowchart_plantuml` | file exists (`tech_spec_to_flowchart.v1.txt`) but **not in `DIAGRAM_PROMPT_MAP`** | no (skipped; repair uses template) |
| **sequence** | **no** | **no** | **no** | **no** | no |
| state / use-case / deployment | no | no | no | no | no |

Canonical API types: `class | object | component | package` (`ALL_DIAGRAM_TYPES` in `app/schemas.py` and `app/prompts_registry.py`).

**Sequence diagrams do not exist** in the generation/verification path. Thesis draft and `scripts/build_training_corpus.py` treat sequence as HF corpus fill / “future work.”

**Flowchart caveat:** internal code + eval + smoke script use it, but `diagram_prompt_name("flowchart")` raises `ValueError`. API will 422 it. `generate_plantuml_code` would crash before builder fallback if someone called it with `flowchart` without hitting the `script_without_types` short-circuit.

---

## 3. Existing tests

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_validators.py` | bounds, package self-dep, nested package OK, braces, empty class/package, bare `package Name;`, worded-arrow normalize, flowchart vs class, sanitize dedupe |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_providers_repair.py` | mock chat/vision; **one** `repair_plantuml` smoke (package self-dep → still has `@startuml`) — **does not assert fixed semantics** |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_orchestration_fallback.py` | `_finetuned_output_needs_fallback` only (generic names / invalid syntax) — **no full `run_single_generation` loop test** |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_spec_json.py` | extract JSON, require entities, prose, heuristic flowchart steps, `ensure_valid_spec` fallback |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_plantuml_from_spec.py` | named concepts, class/package/component builders, `ensure_faithful_plantuml` replaces Module1, structure JSON from Python |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_scoring.py` | composite, majority τ=4, dataset gate, CoT strip |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_vlm_parse.py` | `parse_score_response` SCORE/EXPLANATION |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_package_failures.py` | taxonomy labels only |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_script_no_fake_classes.py` | scripts must not invent classes |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_code_analysis.py` | Python/Java detect, procedural scripts |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_input_prepare.py` | clip + long code → structure spec |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_mock_entities.py` | mock entity extraction |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_api.py` | e2e generate class/object/component/package + human review + analytics |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_security.py` | `!include` strip |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/test_provider_factory.py` | provider routing |

**Missing test coverage vs acceptance spec:** requirement→UML traceability suite, PlantUML compile-only, class/sequence structural rules, hallucination/contradiction, adaptive repair, golden snapshots, repair-iteration metrics, orchestration repair loop.

CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` → `pytest -q` with `MOCK_PROVIDERS=true` + JDK.

---

## 4. Eval / benchmark / sample / golden

### Eval scripts

| Path | What it measures |
|---|---|
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/eval_scenario_code_batch.py` | scenarios + code corpora through `run_single_generation`; ok = render + `@startuml`; by type/language; **no repair-iteration stats**; default `max_repair_attempts=1` |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/eval_live_vlm_reliability.py` | 15 hardcoded cases (incl. flowchart); VLM availability; repair=1 |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/analyze_dataset.py` | VLM score histograms on merged HF parquet |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/uml_pipeline/analyze.py` | `summary_stats`, `plot_score_distributions` |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/smoke_test.py` | live API 5 types + source_code (flowchart will 422 against current schema) |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/generate_dataset.py` | bulk demo gen, repair=0 |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/rerender_failed.py` | re-render + rescore |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/build_scenario_code_corpus.py` | builds 1000+1000 eval JSONL (class/object/component/package/**flowchart**) |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/run_generation.py` / `run_pipeline.py` | legacy CLI batch |

### Sample data

- `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/sample_data/requirements.txt` — 50 NL requirements (no expected UML)
- `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/sample_data/sample_code.py` — User/Order/OrderItem/PaymentService demo

### Eval artifacts (not golden tests)

`/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/data/eval/`:

- `batch_report.json`, `batch_report_summary.json`, `batch_report_live10.json`
- `live_vlm_reliability.json` + summary
- `fidelity_check/fidelity_report.json` (+ v2) — 6 cases (e.g. `nl_library_class`) with entity/rel recall  

**No committed script produces `fidelity_check/`** (no `eval_fidelity.py`). Reports look ad-hoc.

### Golden examples

**None.** No `tests/golden/`, no expected `.puml` snapshots, no requirement→expected-entities fixtures beyond inline unit strings.

---

## 5. Gaps vs acceptance spec

| Spec item | Status | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| **Requirement→UML traceability tests** | Partial helpers only | `extract_named_concepts` + `fidelity_report` + a few unit tests. No suite: requirement → required entities/rels → must appear with correct UML kind. No gold traces. |
| **PlantUML compile gate** | Render-as-compile | No `plantuml -checkonly` / stderr syntax parse. Static regex ≠ compiler. Remote HTTP 400 / Graphviz PNG are the closest. |
| **Diagram-specific structural rules** | Uneven | **Package:** strong. **Flowchart:** decent. **Object/component:** one heuristic each. **Class:** almost none (no “must have classes + legal arrows + members”). **Sequence:** absent. |
| **Semantic completeness / correctness / hallucination / contradiction** | VLM joint score + name recall | Completeness ≈ entity/rel recall. Correctness/hallucination/contradiction = VLM 0–6 only (and human 1–5). No deterministic extra-entity detector, no rel-type mismatch, no “spec says X, diagram says ¬X”. |
| **Adaptive repair by failure category** | Generic LLM repair | Same prompt for all errors. Category taxonomy exists for **package analytics only**. Template fallback only for package/flowchart after failed repair. No brace-fixer / entity-injector / type-rewriter branches. |
| **Dataset metrics report** | Partial analytics | `analytics_summary`: render fails, repair count/success, package taxonomy, majority/dataset rates. Eval batch: ok_rate, fail_reasons, mean S. **Missing:** repair-iteration histogram, success-after-N-repairs, compile vs semantic fail split, per-category repair effectiveness. |
| **Golden regression tests** | Missing | No frozen PlantUML/PNG/spec_json fixtures. `sample_data` is prompts only. |

**VLM vs deterministic (explicit):**

- **Deterministic:** syntax regex, package structural guards, spec-JSON schema, entity/rel **name** recall, `script_without_types`, sanitize/normalize.
- **VLM:** the only semantic quality score; one number covering four paper criteria; majority+composite dataset gate.
- Mock mode makes VLM scores non-semantic (hash 3–5).

---

## 6. Key files to modify

| File | Why |
|---|---|
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/plantuml_validate.py` | Add class/sequence/component/package structural rules; optional compile-result parser; keep `validate_diagram` dispatcher |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/repair.py` | Branch on failure category; keep current LLM+template as last resort |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/orchestration.py` | Compile gate before/alongside render; wire category into `RepairAttempt.reason`; metrics; register flowchart or drop it; sequence type |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/spec_json.py` | Traceability fields (required names/rels from requirement); contradiction/hallucination inputs |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/plantuml_from_spec.py` | Stronger `fidelity_report` (extra entities, rel **type**, sequence messages); builders for new types |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/package_failures.py` | Generalize beyond package; feed repair |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/scoring.py` | Keep VLM; do not treat it as a substitute for deterministic semantic checks |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/prompts_registry.py` + `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/schemas.py` | Align types: add sequence/flowchart or document exclusion; register `tech_spec_to_flowchart` |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/settings.py` | `max_repair_attempts` (3); compile-timeout; category retry policy |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/uml_pipeline/render.py` | Add checkonly/compile helper if you want a true PlantUML gate |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/tests/` | New: traceability, compile, structural-per-type, adaptive repair, golden snapshots, orchestration loop |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/` | Metrics report (success rates + repair iterations); committed fidelity/golden eval; don’t rely on orphan `data/eval/fidelity_check/` |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/repair_plantuml.v1.txt` | Category-specific repair prompts |
| `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/sample_data/` | Golden expected entities/rels/PlantUML per requirement |

---

## Pipeline order (current)

```
requirement/code
  → generate_technical_spec (JSON + 1 retry) + ensure_valid_spec
  → generate_plantuml_code (LoRA/base/mock → validate → spec-builder → ensure_faithful_plantuml)
  → loop: validate_diagram → [repair] → render_plantuml → [repair]
  → template fallback
  → VLM score_image → verify_scores (render gate + majority + S≥3)
```

That is the full current stack: strong on package syntax + render + VLM dataset gate; weak on class/sequence structure, true compile, adaptive repair, and golden/traceability regression.
